name: Westfield Century City
description: Westfield Century City is a premier open-air luxury shopping destination in West Los Angeles, featuring high-end retailers like Tiffany & Co., Bloomingdale's, and Nordstrom alongside innovative dining experiences from Eataly to Din Tai Fung. This extensively renovated center combines world-class shopping with entertainment including AMC Theatres, creating a sophisticated outdoor retail environment in the heart of Century City's business and entertainment district.
demographics: Affluent West Los Angeles residents, entertainment industry professionals, tourists, and international shoppers seeking luxury and upscale retail experiences
summary: An upscale open-air shopping center featuring luxury retailers, gourmet dining, and entertainment in the heart of West Los Angeles.
